validity_findings: Server compression fix validated: All 5760 observations show Content-Encoding='br' or 'gzip' (0 'none'). The parent MEASUREMENT_INVALID infrastructure failure is resolved.

Decompressed discrimination of 0.5 is structurally capped by 3-way error collapse (no_auth/expired_token/invalid_token share error body). This is a property of the mock server design, not the mechanism. The decision rule threshold (>=0.3) is met but the test has low discriminative power above the structural ceiling.

Nominal payload sizes (1KB/10KB/100KB) do not produce proportional compressed-size variation for brotli: JSON/XML brotli compressed bodies stay at ~69-72 bytes across all three sizes; HTML brotli at ~172-200 bytes. The decompression path is exercised (latency scales with nominal size: 0.015ms→0.21ms for JSON brotli) but wire-size variation is minimal. The 'multi-size' claim is bounded to nominal uncompressed size targets.

Brotli quality diversity (unique compressed hashes per state) does not increase from 1KB to 100KB (avg 2.33 vs 2.33 for HTML; 2.0 vs 2.0 for JSON/XML). This is an artifact of repetitive padding content, not a mechanism failure. C_BROTLI_QUALITY_SCALING fails as reported but is not a gating condition per frozen decision_rule.
No CDN noise applied by design (isolates content-type/size effects). Real-CDN survival remains the sole blocker for C-MEAS-VALID per the handoff chain.
Single mock server per condition (sequential ports) avoids concurrency but does not exercise CDN edge sharding or caching behaviors.
Decompression latency measured on localhost only (0.015-0.21ms brotli, 0.015-0.25ms gzip); production network/CDN latency not measured.

Compressed-only discrimination: brotli JSON 0.32-0.34, HTML 0.15-0.17, XML 0.33-0.34; gzip always 0.50. Gap confirms decompression is necessary for format-invariance; brotli quality cycling reduces compressed discrimination via cross-state collisions.
claim_ceiling: Decompression-normalization (SHA256 on decompressed body + status) preserves body-only discrimination >= 0.3 for HTML and XML at nominal uncompressed sizes 1KB/10KB/100KB under localhost brotli (quality 4-8) and gzip compression without CDN noise. Structural ceiling is 0.5 due to 3-way error collapse. Actual compressed wire sizes for brotli do not scale with nominal payload size (JSON/XML ~70 bytes, HTML ~180 bytes across all sizes) due to repetitive padding. Real-CDN infrastructure remains untested.
